name: Machrihanish Holiday Park
stayType: Holiday park with caravans, lodges, pods and pitches
accommodation: Two- and three-bedroom caravans, hot tub lodges sleeping four, heated lodges and camping pods, and touring and camping pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes
suitableFor: Families, couples, campers, van travellers and dog owners
dogs: Dog-friendly caravans, hot tub lodges and camping pods can be booked online
confirmedFeatures: Wi-Fi, washrooms, accessible facilities, heated lodges and pods open all year, private hot tubs on some lodges, views to Islay and Jura
overview: Machrihanish Holiday Park is in Machrihanish village near Campbeltown, a 10-minute walk from the beach. You can book caravans, hot tub lodges, heated camping pods or touring and tent pitches, with views across to Islay and Jura. There is Wi-Fi, accessible washrooms, and a pub and restaurants within walking distance.
surfTripFit: Being a short walk from Machrihanish beach, with year-round heated pods and pitches for vans, it suits surfers visiting outside the summer as well as in it.
